sections.heading: Revive High DTI Files
sections.body: With UFF's Non-QM Core program, high DTI files are not the end of the road. By strategically combining asset depletion and other income streams, brokers can boost qualifying income. This unique approach leverages a 36-month divisor, providing a competitive edge.
bullets: Use asset depletion to supplement income.
Combine with bank statements or W-2s for optimal results.

sections.heading: Boost Your Qualifying Income
sections.body: Our innovative method significantly enhances income calculations, reducing DTI ratios from disqualifying levels to acceptable ones. This can be the key to transforming a decline into a successful approval.
bullets: Example: Self-employed and salaried income combined with assets.
DTI shift: From 52.87% to 40.99% using a 36-month divisor.
